$comment: CROSS-REPO CONTRACT — single source of truth for the signalgrid-mcp posture_report shape the macos-posture connector consumes. The Review-Hub side proves the connector consumes `example` to `expected` (folded into proof:macos-posture). The signalgrid-mcp side proves its live signalgrid_posture_report() still EMITS every requiredSection + requiredSecurityControl (tests/test_posture_contract.py, which reads this file when SIGNALGRID_CONTRACT_PATH is set). `pnpm run verify:all` runs both against this one file. Change the shape on either side and a gate fails instead of the two drifting silently.
